data.title: Elterngeld decision for Emil
data.summary: The Landesamt für Soziales Beispielmünde – Elterngeldstelle approved Basiselterngeld of €1,412.35 per month for your child Emil (born 14 August 2026) for the 1st to 12th month of life; no payment is made for months 1 and 2 because Mutterschaftsgeld is offset against it.
data.explanation: This is a decision (Bescheid) from the Landesamt für Soziales approving your Elterngeld application for your child Emil. You will receive €1,412.35 per month as Basiselterngeld for months 1–12 of the child's life, but months 1 and 2 pay nothing because the amount is offset against your maternity benefit (Mutterschaftsgeld). If your income changes during this period, notify the office right away. If you disagree with any part of the decision, you may file an objection (Widerspruch); the app shows the deadline. Elterngeld itself is tax-free, but it affects the tax rate applied to your other income (Progressionsvorbehalt), so keep this notice for your tax return.
